newsitem.title: TAIWAN: China Steel starts up T$57.4 bln plant.
newsitem.headline: China Steel starts up T$57.4 bln plant.

text.p: China Steel Corp, Taiwan's largest steelmaker, said its new T$57.4 billion steel plant began operations on Monday.
The company held a blowing-in ceremony on Monday for the plant's blast furnance, symbolising its completion and startup.
The furnance is the heart of the steel plant, China Steel's fourth.
The expansion, launched in mid-1994, will increase annual steel production capacity to 8.05 million tonnes from 5.65 million, the company said in a statement.
China Steel was privatised by the state in April 1995.
